# Entity Model

Git's domain model is a **content-addressable object graph** rather than a
relational schema. The entities below correspond to the four Git object types
plus the ref and index structures.

---

## Blob

**File**: `blob.h` / `blob.c`

Represents raw file content. Immutable once stored.

| Field | Type | Notes |
|-------|------|-------|
| `oid` | `struct object_id` | SHA-1 or SHA-256 hash of the content |
| `size` | `unsigned long` | Byte length |
| (content) | `void *` | Raw bytes, loaded on demand via ODB |

**Relationships:** referenced by Tree entries.

---

## Tree

**File**: `tree.h` / `tree.c`

Represents a directory snapshot — an ordered list of entries mapping names
to blobs or sub-trees.

| Field | Type | Notes |
|-------|------|-------|
| `oid` | `struct object_id` | Hash of the serialised tree |
| `buffer` | `void *` | Raw tree data (entries: mode + name + oid) |
| `size` | `unsigned long` | Buffer length |

**Relationships:** contains 0..N entries each pointing to a Blob or Tree; referenced by Commit.

---

## Commit

**File**: `commit.h` / `commit.c`

Represents a project snapshot with authorship and lineage metadata.

| Field | Type | Notes |
|-------|------|-------|
| `oid` | `struct object_id` | Hash of the commit |
| `tree` | `struct tree *` | Root tree snapshot |
| `parents` | `struct commit_list *` | 0..N parent commits (merge has >1) |
| `author` | `char *` | Author identity + timestamp |
| `committer` | `char *` | Committer identity + timestamp |
| `message` | `const char *` | Full commit message |
| `graph_pos` | `uint32_t` | Position in commit-graph file (if loaded) |
| `generation` | `timestamp_t` | Commit-graph generation number |

**Relationships:** points to one Tree; has 0..N parent Commits; referenced by Ref/Tag.

---

## Tag

**File**: `tag.h` / `tag.c`

Annotated tag — a signed or unsigned wrapper around any Git object.

| Field | Type | Notes |
|-------|------|-------|
| `oid` | `struct object_id` | Hash of the tag object |
| `tagged` | `struct object *` | Object being tagged (usually a Commit) |
| `tag` | `const char *` | Tag name string |
| `tagger` | `char *` | Tagger identity + timestamp |
| `message` | `const char *` | Tag message / GPG signature |

**Relationships:** points to any Git object (typically Commit).

---

## Ref

**File**: `refs.h` / `refs/` backends

A named pointer to an object OID. Supports branches, tags, and special refs.

| Field | Type | Notes |
|-------|------|-------|
| name | `const char *` | Full refname e.g. `refs/heads/main` |
| oid | `struct object_id` | Target object hash |
| symref target | `const char *` | For symbolic refs (e.g. `HEAD → refs/heads/main`) |
| flags | `unsigned int` | `REF_ISSYMREF`, `REF_ISPACKED`, etc. |

**Backends:** files, packed, reftable (selectable per repository).
**Relationships:** points to Commit (branches), Tag (annotated tags), or Commit directly (lightweight tags).

---

## Index (Staging Area)

**File**: `read-cache.h` / `read-cache.c`

The index (`.git/index`) is the staging area between the working tree and commits.

| Field | Type | Notes |
|-------|------|-------|
| `cache_nr` | `int` | Number of entries |
| `cache` | `struct cache_entry **` | Array of staged file entries |
| `cache_changed` | `unsigned int` | Dirty flag |
| entry.oid | `struct object_id` | Blob OID for staged content |
| entry.name | `const char *` | Path relative to work-tree root |
| entry.mode | `unsigned int` | File mode (100644, 100755, 120000, etc.) |
| entry.stat | stat fields | mtime, ctime, dev, ino for change detection |

**Relationships:** entries reference Blob objects; used to construct Tree on commit.

---

## Remote

**File**: `remote.h` / `remote.c`

Configuration for a remote repository.

| Field | Type | Notes |
|-------|------|-------|
| `name` | `const char *` | Remote name (e.g. `origin`) |
| `url` | `const char **` | Fetch URLs |
| `pushurl` | `const char **` | Push URLs (may differ) |
| `fetch` | `struct refspec *` | Fetch refspecs |
| `push` | `struct refspec *` | Push refspecs |

**Relationships:** associated with zero or more Refs (tracking branches).
